title: Distance-Shell Tomography: Geometric Certificates for Fault-Tolerant Sensing, Moment Compression, and Hypercube Equalization
summary: Substantive Lean development for labelled distance-shell observations of anonymous integer populations. The focused 14-statement interface covers six result groups. Square grids have an exact four-corner interval-cut characterization of recovery of all populations of mass at most two after one erased report, an equivalent distance-sum compression contract, and exact corner-constrained optimum ceil(3(n+1)/2) for every n at least 3.
